question: Can the NCR locality cell for Laguna Lake in the DENR-BMB 2019 inland-wetlands inventory be linked to current PSA city codes without treating those codes as the lake boundary?
method: Reviewed the NCR row on page 3 of the official DENR-BMB 2019 inland-wetlands PDF and matched its two printed city names against the PSA NCR PSGC city table. Checked the PSA 3Q 2026 release/current PSGC date for intervening updates. Linked both codes to the existing singular Laguna de Bay research lead as source-described locality context only. The BMB table is a historical selected inventory; the locality associations do not define lake extent, shoreline, city overlap, access, or fish presence.

decisions.decision: Keep Laguna de Bay as one canonical shared-water research lead and link the BMB 2019 NCR locality cell to PSA codes for Muntinlupa and Taguig under NCR L2; record the relationship as source-described locality context only.

limitations: The BMB 2019 inventory is historical and selected; its locality text is not a current or complete lake inventory.
NCR city associations do not imply that the lake lies wholly within either city, define shorelines, or create separate lake features.
PSA city codes identify administrative units only; no polygon, shoreline, coordinate, or legal jurisdiction was imported or inferred.
No fish assertion, habitat classification change, access/safety/rules claim, or public-app record is added.
The NCR baseline and Luzon phase remain incomplete; scopeFrozen remains false.
